title: Seven Cows
text: … seven cows, sleek and well-fed, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.

title: Seven Heads of Grain
text: Seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, came up on one stalk.

title: A Troubled Spirit
text: In the morning his spirit was troubled, so he summoned all the magicians and wise men of Egypt.

title: I Recall My Failures
text: Today I recall my failures.

title: Out of the Dungeon
text: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, who was quickly brought out of the dungeon.

title: God Will Give an Answer
text: I myself cannot do it, | but God will give Pharaoh a sound answer.

title: Two Dreams in One
text: The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same.

title: Seven Years
text: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven ripe heads of grain are seven years.

title: Seven Years of Famine
text: … but seven years of famine will follow them.

title: A Discerning and Wise Man
text: Now, therefore, Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.

title: The Spirit of God
text: Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?

title: The Signet Ring
text: Then Pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger, put it on Joseph’s finger …

title: Bow the Knee
text: He had Joseph ride in his second chariot, with men calling out before him, “Bow the knee!”

title: A New Name
text: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah …

title: Thirty Years Old
text: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

title: Beyond Measure
text: … like the sand of the sea, that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.

title: Manasseh
text: God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household.

title: Ephraim
text: God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.

title: The Famine Began
text: … the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said.

title: Go to Joseph
text: Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you.

title: Every Nation
text: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain …

title: No One Could Tell
text: … but no one could interpret them for him.

title: Asenath
text: … and he gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife.

title: Too Much to Count
text: … that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.

title: Beside the Nile
text: … He was standing beside the Nile …

title: A Hungry World
text: … because the famine was severe over all the earth.

title: The Bread of Life
text: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
